title: perf(canary): adaptive auto-detection and hysteresis rollout guards for latency/throughput regressions
author: Priya Shah
description: Problem/Context: Our perf canary system has been generating noisy signals for short-lived spikes and KV-cache churn, occasionally causing unnecessary rollbacks during gradual rollouts. This causes wasted capacity and slows safe rollouts. Objective: Add adaptive auto-detection and hysteresis-aware rollout guards that consider latency and throughput distributions, KV cache pressure, and recent regression history to avoid flapping. Changes: 1) new detector module (perf/canary/detector.py) implements distribution-based anomaly scoring (EWMA + MAD) and dynamic thresholds per route/model; 2) hysteresis controller (perf/canary/hysteresis.py) introduces hold windows and backoff on repeated toggles; 3) KV-aware heuristics that increase thresholds for cases with high cache eviction rates; 4) rollout guard config surface (infra/deploy/canary-config.yaml) with tunable sensitivity, min-duration, and hysteresis params; 5) observability: new metrics (canary.anomaly_score, canary.hysteresis_state) and a console dashboard (console/dashboards/perf_canary.json) with example alert rules; 6) tests and a small migration to storage schema for canary snapshots. This PR is the implementation of ENG-1843 and ENG-1999 and is intended to reduce false-positive canary failures while preserving fast detection of true regressions. Checklist: - [x] Detector prototype validated on historical traces (see analysis/bench/2026-01-canary-replay) - [x] Unit + integration tests (tests/perf/test_canary_detection.py) - [x] Dashboard and alert examples added - [x] Backwards compatible config with sensible defaults - [x] Docs/Runbook updated (docs/perf/canary-runbooks.md) Rollout plan: merged behind a feature flag. Will enable for a subset of canaries for 48h then widen after telemetry review.
commits: 5 commits: 1) add adaptive detector and initial tests; 2) add hysteresis controller and integration with canary runner; 3) KV-cache heuristics and metrics; 4) dashboard + runbook; 5) add gating feature flag and update CI matrix.

ci_details: CI: initial run failed (integration test timeout on perf-canary suite) due to an overly long synthetic trace in tests; reduced synthetic trace length and retriggered. Subsequent run passed all checks: unit, integration, lint, typecheck, and perf-canary matrix. Canary smoke job in staging exercised feature flag successfully.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash-merge after approvals and green CI. PR closed and merged into main. Feature gated behind 'canary_autodetect_v2' flag for staged rollout.
release_notes: - Introduce adaptive canary auto-detection using EWMA+MAD scoring. - Add hysteresis-based rollout guards to reduce flapping. - KV-cache aware thresholds to avoid false positives during cache churn. - New canary metrics and dashboard for observability.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature flag 'canary_autodetect_v2' on staging for 48h. Monitor metrics: canary.anomaly_score, canary.hysteresis_state, canary.false_positive_rate. If unexpected rollbacks occur, toggle flag off and run 'scripts/replay_canary_traces.sh' against historical traces to reproduce.
reproduction_steps: 1) Run analysis/bench/2026-01-canary-replay.ipynb to replay historical traces. 2) Toggle feature flag in pkg/config/feature_flags.go to enable for a specific project. 3) Observe metrics in console/dashboards/perf_canary.json and alerts for canary.anomaly_score > 0.8. 4) If necessary, adjust sensitivity in infra/deploy/canary-config.yaml.
safety_considerations: Keep feature behind flag. Defaults chosen conservatively to prioritize availability over sensitivity. Hysteresis prevents automatic rollbacks without human confirmation if repeated toggles detected.
notes: Post-merge: schedule a telemetry review at +72h and a retrospective on false positives after 2 weeks of traffic.
